citations.claim: first violating step: controller_force 278.04 exceeds fmax 11.515; body speed 16.63 near waypoint
one step earlier force was clamped exactly at fmax 11.515 with similar speed 16.96
initial high speed 53.5 was clamped correctly; only the final close-to-waypoint step spikes

counterfactual.change: moved single waypoint from (11.5,11) to (1,11) so the body never enters the close-to-waypoint zone within 16 steps; force stays clamped and no violation occurs

explanation: The controller clamps force at fmax during cruise (steps 13-15 report exactly 11.515) but the clamp is missing on the close-to-waypoint branch. When the body approaches within ~1-1.6 of the waypoint at (11.5,11) at step 16, it switches to an unclamped arrival/hold law (large kp-driven command ~278, 24x fmax), violating the limit. Moving the waypoint far away keeps the controller in the clamped cruise branch and the violation disappears.
vision_note: The red controlled body moves leftward toward the green waypoint across steps 13 to 15, steadily closing the gap. At step 16 it arrives essentially on top of the waypoint, matching a cruise-to-arrival transition at the violation step.
